_comment: Answers read by a person where the matcher looks for a phrase the answer words differently. Per arm and question id.

q06.note: says plain text and 4 096 ký tự; the matcher wants "văn bản thuần"

q10.note: says 40 lines per group and the rest is counted, in other words

q16.note: says the score was 1 - norm and the fix is score = norm

q20.note: lists every step in order; the matcher wants "routing in cli.ts"
